Class FieldMap

public without sharing class FieldMap

Wrapper class for the FieldMapping__mdt custom metadata object.


Change History

  • 07/11/2021   Initial version.
  • 07/13/2021   Add support for negative numbers.
  • 02/23/2023   Add support for Hash__c field.
  • 09/02/2024   Class moved from Tools to its own class.
  • 09/03/2024   Add support for default values.
  • 05/05/2025   Add support for MappingType__c and FormulaValue__c fields.
  • 06/26/2025   Add support for ScalingFactor__c and ExternalIdObjectAndField__c fields.
  • 07/12/2025   Add support for IsRequired__c field.

Group:
    Data Transfer Objects (DTO)

Properties

public Object defaultValue

Default value as an object. The type of the object depends on the field type.

Since:
    09/03/2024

private final String defaultValueAsString

Default value as a string.

Since:
    09/03/2024

public String externalIdObjectAndField

If the value represents an external ID, this field contains the target object and field name in the format Object.Field. For example, if the target field is an external ID on the Product2 object, this field would be Product2.ExternalIdField__c.

Since:
    06/26/2025

public String formulaValue

Formula value. Maps the calculated value to the target field.

public Boolean hash

Flag to indicate if a hash needs to be calculated.

Since:
    02/23/2023

public Boolean isRequired

Indicates if the field is required. If true, the field must be populated: for date, datetime, boolean and numeric fields, the value must not be null; for text fields, the value must not be blank (i.e., not null and not an empty string).

Since:
    07/12/2025

public String mappingType

Mapping type. Valid values are:
- Field
- Fixed
- Formula

public Decimal scalingFactor

A decimal value used to convert a stored number into its actual or display value. For example, if values are stored as integers (e.g., 100 representing $1.00), a scalingFactor of 0.01 can be applied to calculate the real-world value.

Since:
    06/26/2025

Source field name.

public String type

Field type. Valid values are:
- Boolean
- Date
- Datetime,
- Decimal
